abilities.name: Commander
abilities.text: Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers, completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

abilities.name: Crushing Grip
abilities.text: Select one Enemy Unit Within 12″. That Unit counts as Activated in this Phase (set an Activation Marker next to it).

abilities.name: Mutating Carapace
abilities.text: Select one Enemy Unit Within 18″. This Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against all attacks made by the selected Enemy Unit, with a +2 Modifier applied to those Evade Rolls.

abilities.name: Leaping Strike
abilities.text: If Unengaged, resolve the PLACE (6) effect.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (4) 4+ effect.
